frozen_rule: per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: CONTAMINATED iff (recorded_anchor INTERSECT answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER)) is non-empty; NOT_CONTAMINATED otherwise. The run verdict is COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_FALSIFIED iff at least one measured bundle is CONTAMINATED and all five non-vacuity controls pass; COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_NOT_FALSIFIED iff no measured bundle is CONTAMINATED and all five controls pass; ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS iff any control fails, any pin drifts before or after execution, or the measurable population is empty. CONTAMINATED is a set intersection on the product's own tokenisation and stoplist: there is NO count, rate, frequency, share or percentage threshold anywhere in the rule, and none may be introduced after the result is seen. The topicality measures are REPORTED-ONLY and can never change the verdict.

numeric_environment: Python 3 (CPython), pure-Python set operations on committed bundle bytes and the product's own pure-Python tokeniser: no BLAS/numpy reduction order, no float comparison, no rounding anywhere in the rule. The product's `answer_key_terms` and `plan_adversarial_queries` are pure functions (no network, no clock, no randomness), so the whole measurement is deterministic and re-runnable.
pin_discipline: The engine re-hashes every pin BEFORE measurement (fail-closed: drift -> exit 2, zero measured bundles, never a product verdict) and AGAIN after execution, publishing both hash sets in the result. The population manifest is re-derived from the source tree and compared with the frozen digest, so a hand-picked or substituted bundle list cannot satisfy the pin.
